# Logo assets

The `django-datastar` logo combines an original lowercase `d` with Datastar's
pixel-art rocket.

`datastar-rocket.png` is the static 512×512 rocket published by Datastar and is
used with permission:

- Source: <https://data-star.dev/static/images/rocket-512x512-d36eedfbf7dd91899cc8a6b7906cafec20787b5e6b542f699b4358a67ab95a1d.png>
- SHA-256: `d36eedfbf7dd91899cc8a6b7906cafec20787b5e6b542f699b4358a67ab95a1d`

The SVG logo files embed that exact PNG so they remain self-contained when used
as browser images or outside the documentation site.
